correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the permutation-cell indicator covariance (delta_row-1/k)(delta_col-1/k)/(k-1) and summed it over anti-diagonal row intervals to obtain [k^2 m_t 1_{s=t}-2k h_st+m_s m_t]/[k^2(k-1)]. Nested same-side row intervals force strictly negative off-diagonal numerators; for opposite-side intervals h=max(0,a+b-k), yielding N=ab-2k max(0,a+b-k) and exact hyperbola sign criterion in both a+b regimes. Positive b counts are ceil(2k(k-a)/(2k-a))-1 per left a; bounded ceiling error permits the Riemann integral 2-2 log2 divided by 2 asymptotic unordered pairs. At most one b per a gives zero. Variance kernel: the zero-variance linear statistic is constant across permutations; swapping two rows and two columns enforces all second differences zero, so only span{1,t}, with k=2 included. Trace follows from sum m_t^2=(2k^3+k)/3. Direct independent exhaustive permutation enumeration k=2..6 confirmed rational covariances/signs/trace; finite enumeration is not an all-k proof.

The covariance has rank 2k-3 and exact trace k-1/3-1/(3k).
